newsitem.title: USA: Dura Pharma, Genentech in pact.
newsitem.headline: Dura Pharma, Genentech in pact.

text.p: Dura Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday that it has signed a license, development and supply agreement with Genentech Inc, involving the application of Dura's proprietary Spiros pulmonary drug delivery technology to macromolecules.
Under the agreement, Dura will collaborate with Genentech to develop a novel protein in Dura's Spiros inhalation system.

Dura will be responsible for formulation, development and manufacturing of the finished dosage form and will supply Spiros inhalers to Genentech for clinical testing, commercialization and marketing, it said.
Genentech will be responsible for clinical development.
Dura will receive a signing fee, R&D funding, milestone payments, manufacturing supply profit and royalties on product sales.
Genentech and its sublicensees will have worldwide rights to market products developed under the agreement.
Dura will immediately begin formulation and preclinical work to incorporate Genentech's protein into the Spiros System, it said.
Dura said it also has an agreement with an unnamed major pharmaceutical company for the delivery of an unnamed macromolecule in the Spiros System.
